dataList.content:
A mysterious case of missing persons in a street shrouded in thick, heavy fog...
在浓雾笼罩的街道上发生的神秘失踪案啊……
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
It's... almost as if we're in the middle of some scary urban legend. Not that I’m scared... Not at all. Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha.
就好像……在经历什么灵异传说一样。啊，我可一点都不怕啊……哈。哈。哈。

Don’t force yourself to laugh, Sinclair.
不必强颜欢笑，辛克莱。

I don't like this at all~ We're this scared so soon after entering the nest?
这可不是什么好兆头啊~上来就发生这样的事，好担心以后还会发生什么。

Everyone seems to be on edge, thanks to the unsettling story we heard earlier.
由于之前听到的那令人不安的故事，巴士里的气氛越加微妙。

... I know what to do.
这种时候就要……

<Hey, Heathcliff. That invitation… can you read it out loud for us again?>
<希斯克利夫，那份……邀请函。你能再给我们读一次听听吗？>

It'll be a good idea to remind ourselves of our current mission. Besides, I could use a refresher myself.
让大家回忆一遍我们任务的内容感觉挺不错的。此外，我自己也有些不确定的地方。

Hmph… It’s just an invitation. There ain't anything special about it.
嗯……这就是个邀请函。有什么好读的。

The neatly folded invitation Heathcliff produced from his pockets completely betrayed his attempt at appearing aloof. It was folded with such tender care that it almost resembled a neat paper craft. He cleared his throat.
……他一边这么说着，一边从怀里取出宛如纸工艺品般折得整整齐齐的邀请函。

Ahem.
咳。

Some time later...
不久之后……

"... Please, honour this occasion with your presence."
……敬请光临，您的到来必令寒舍蓬荜生辉。

"… With great respect, Nelly."
……谨启，耐莉。

And…? And…?
然后呢……然后呢？

… Bollocks.
……啧。

"Y-you have to be here, Heath. I’ll be waiting. - Cathy".
绝、绝对要来哦，希斯。我会等着你的。……凯茜。

Daaamn...
噢……

Oho~!
哦嚯~！

… This wasn’t exactly what I had in mind when I asked him to read that letter.
……我可没想过要营造出这样的氛围。

Ugh... What are we, a party crowd at some dive bar?
呃……什么情况，我们这是什么街边小酒馆吗？

Oh, that wasn't what we were going for?
诶，我们不是要营造这种氛围吗？

I knew that this would happen… I ain't even mad.
我就知道会这样……都没心思生气了。

Besides… all she said is that she’d be waiting. She never said she missed me or 'wanted' to see me.
而且……她只说了会等我。她可没说什么思念或者想见我……之类的。

C’mon, bud. Just look at the way she wrote it. Here...
哎呦，但是啊，你看看这儿写的……

Lemme see, lemme see~
我看看我看看~

Some Sinners gather in a circle like they’re doing a literary analysis of the invitation letter. Maybe I was worrying too much.
几名罪人围成一圈，好像在对邀请函的内容进行逐字逐句地分析，也许我的担心是多余的。

Haha… they’re like school kids opening their first love letters.
哈哈……简直就像第一次收到情书的学生一样。

What, were ya never ever interested in those things, Sinclair?
怎么啦，辛克莱对这些没兴趣吗？

I was…! I was… a good, diligent student. The only things I ever cared about were my textbooks and the school lectures!
我……！我……以前可是个用功的好学生。我只对教科书和黑板上的内容感兴趣。

Sinclair, thy countenance appeareth to be turning rosy agai—
辛克莱，汝的脸又红起来了！

For the last time, I said! It’s! Genetics!!!
我之前说过了这是体质的原因！！！

What about you, Dante?!
那么……但丁呢？！

O-oh, nevermind...
没、没什么……

<Hey, what’s with that oddly sorry look on your face…?>
<……为什么你闪烁其辞还带着一脸抱歉的表情啊……>

The manager has no need for your sympathy. I am certain that there are those who appreciate their unique appearance.
不必感到难过。这个世界上存在着各种癖好的人。

Is it not… odd?
……话说回来，这不是异象吗？

What, that someone actually wrote Heathcliff a love letter?
你指希斯克利夫先生会收到情书这件事吗？

Oh my, Yi Sang… that is such a rude thing to say...
李箱先生……你说的话有点伤人了……

N-no, I had no intention of relaying such crass sentiments to... I—
不、不是，我不是那个意思，我……

Just kidding, Yi Sang. Just kidding. I was actually thinking the same thing.
只是开个玩笑，玩笑而已。因为我也有和李箱先生一样的想法。

Since we’re not looking for a Lobotomy Corp. branch of T Corp., since we’re heading to this 'Wuthering Heights' manor instead...
既然我们要去的不是位于T公司某处的脑叶公司支部，而是去这座名叫“呼啸山庄”的宅邸……

… I suppose that that’s where we’ll find the Golden Bough.
……也就是说我们得到那里，才能取得金枝吧。

That was precisely what I had intended to convey, Miss Ishmael.
我想表达的正是如此，以实玛利女士。

Thank you for bringing that up. I was starting to get tired of being the bringer of unpleasant news.
我已经快要厌倦充当一个泼冷水的人了，所以我根本没提这事，感谢你适时指了出来。

Hopefully, none of you are under the impression that we're headed to Wuthering Heights just because of some invitation Heathcliff received. Because if you are... you'll be sorely disappointed.
要是你们以为去呼啸山庄的理由只是因为希斯克利夫收到的那张邀请函，那我会非常失望的。

Right, so if we're lookin' at the context she wrote this in, what she's really tryin' to say here is...
这么说从头捋一遍的话……她真正想说的是……

No, no. Bud, you gotta look at the tone she used here.
不不，你看这儿她用的语气……

… Sure. Moving on.
好吧……总之继续吧。

There was a report from the LCCB that a Golden Bough has been observed.
来自LCCB的报告记载了对金枝的观测结果。

They narrowed its location down to somewhere within the Wuthering Heights manor...
其位置就处于呼啸山庄宅邸的某处……

But there was a significant risk, on account of the manor's unique security system, that prevented the Before Team from conducting their on-site preliminary survey. The exact location of the Bough is yet to be identified.
但是，由于特殊的安保系统导致LCCB部队的潜入存在极大风险，因此无法得知金枝的具体位置。

Unique… security measures? Not sure if I remember anything like that.
特殊的安保系统……？还有那种东西吗？

Right, then it’s even more… odd. No other ways to put it.
这样的话，这就更加……没错，更加……异常了。

Indeed. Though I remain ignorant of the monetary value and the public perception of its worth...
同感。虽然我们仍无法准确把握金枝的价值及地位……

… I do know that the Golden Bough is not an item so easily obtainable that it may be housed in a normal, private manor.
但也没有理由能在一座平凡的宅邸里找到那般贵重之物。

It can be shared that the Golden Bough wasn’t… always located inside the manor.
可以这么说吧……金枝最初被找到的位置，并不在宅邸中。

I see. Then, the Golden Bough, its previous location in an unknown area within the T Corp.’s Lobotomy Corp. branch, has been transferred to the manor for a reason we are yet to be aware of.
也就是说，位于T公司脑叶公司支部某处……的金枝，由于某些原因被转移到了宅邸内。

Right. Then... this ‘Catherine’ person will be a major part of this operation.
名为凯瑟琳的人物很可能是此次作战的核心。

To have a Golden Bough all to herself in that manor...
在自家的宅邸中持有着金枝的人……

And she’s gotta be one confident woman, too. Confident enough to believe that Heathcliff will come to the manor just to see her face, even if it wasn’t for the Golden Bough.
而且……她肯定十分有自信，毫不怀疑即使不用金枝做诱饵，希斯克利夫先生也会为了见自己而前往宅邸。

None of this conversation seemed to even register to Heathcliff, however.
然而，身为这一事件核心人物的希斯克利夫似乎并不在意这些事情。

Oi, lemme know if you see a barbershop or a boutique nearby.
那个，要是周围有理发店精品店什么的就跟我说一声。

... This isn't a tour bus, Heathcliff. We will not make unnecessary stops like the ones you suggest.
……难道你觉得这是一辆每到一个地标就会停靠下来的观光巴士吗。

Right, I get it. Then why don’t you just leave me behind and go on ahead? I’ll catch up...
那到时候也可以让我先下车，你们走你们的，我之后再赶上来……

So Heathcliff… I’ve been watching the shops very closely...
我一直认真观察着呢，希斯克利夫先生。

… but I haven't noticed a single open shop. It might be because of the rumors from earlier, and the fog...
不知道是不是因为先前听到的那则传言，在这个时间段我没有看到任何一家开门的商店。也可能是雾的缘故。

Why don’t you just leave it to us? Rodya and I...
果然还是就交给我和罗佳小姐……

What the hell are you... Wait, WAIT!
喂……等会，等会！
